overviewParagraphs: Twin Doves Golf Club is widely regarded as one of the finest private clubs in southern Vietnam. Comprising the Luna, Stella, and Sole nines, the 27-hole complex provides a diverse test of golf in an idyllic setting just one hour from the bustling center of Ho Chi Minh City.

The Luna Course winds through gentle hills and mature forests, requiring pinpoint accuracy off the tee. The Stella Course demands a strategic approach, with natural creeks and lakes coming into play on almost every hole. Finally, the Sole Course offers a challenging links-style feel, characterized by strategic bunkering and island greens.

Beyond the immaculate course conditioning, Twin Doves is renowned for its exceptional facilities. The sweeping, contemporary clubhouse overlooks the 18th greens, providing an expansive space for post-round relaxation, a well-stocked pro shop, and world-class dining spanning Vietnamese, Korean, and Western cuisines.

curatorBriefHtml: Twin Doves Golf Club is a premier Par 72 (Any 18) championship layout in Binh Duong, Vietnam, crafted by Peter Rousseau (P+Z) (2011) and stretching to 7,234 Yards across a championship layout environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its 27-hole rotation (luna, stella, sole) (Diverse architectural styles) and course conditioning & deep bunkering (Paspalum carpets and crisp sand).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, Twin Doves Golf Club (Resort & Visitor Access via AGS) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Vietnam dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its caddie pacing & etiquette (Polished and highly trained), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Binh Duong golf tour by AGS, Twin Doves Golf Club provides a distinct architectural test by Peter Rousseau (P+Z) that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.
